gitCommit.subject: feat(canvas): enable frame publish to artwork (#1351)
gitCommit.body:
feat(canvas): enable frame publish to artwork (#1351)

* feat(canvas): expose frame tool in toolbar

Added frame tool to the canvas toolbar's baseTools array with Frame icon. Frame tool was previously defined as a canvas tool but not displayed in the toolbar. This change makes it accessible to users via the UI.

Changes:
- Add 'frame' to Tool union type in store/tool-state.ts
- Add frame tool config to baseTools in useToolbarShortcuts hook
- Import Frame icon from lucide-react
- Add toolbar.addFrame translation to all 4 locales (en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW)

The frame tool is positioned between the video tool (commented out) and select tool in the toolbar.

* feat(canvas): add frame container system with move, resize, and visibility fixes

Introduce FrameObject as a new container type alongside Panel. Frames are
axis-aligned rectangles that clip children and support drag-to-create,
move, resize via Transformer, and automatic child containment on drop.

Key fixes:
- Change `!object.visible` to `object.visible === false` so objects
  without an explicit visible property are rendered correctly
- Render frame border outside clipFunc Group to prevent stroke clipping
- Add ctx.beginPath() in frame clipFunc for proper path initialization
- Set `visible: true` on newly created frames

* fix(canvas): allow clicking child objects inside frames

Frame border Rect was intercepting all clicks in the frame's interior,
preventing selection of child objects. Added a donut-shaped hitFunc so
only the border edges respond to clicks, and disabled listening on
transparent frame backgrounds.

* fix(canvas): allow dragging objects out of frames

Add SelectedNodeInPanel overlay to frame rendering, matching the pattern
used by panels. Selected frame children now render a draggable overlay
outside the clip group, enabling drag-out via updateFrameContainment.

Also expose isDrawingFrame to prevent frame-level drag during frame
drawing.

* fix(canvas): align frame Transformer handles with frame border

The Transformer was computing its bounding box from the frame Group's
getClientRect(), which included child content extending beyond the frame.
This caused handles to appear at the child image's size instead of the
frame's actual size.

- Attach Transformer to the border Rect instead of the Group
- Replace clipFunc with explicit clipX/clipY/clipWidth/clipHeight
- Only show solid blue border when frame itself is selected
- Hide Transformer's own border (frame border Rect provides it)
- Convert border Rect local coords to absolute in onTransformEnd

* fix(canvas): allow dragging frame objects by keeping border listening when selected

The frame border Rect had listening={false} when the frame was selected,
leaving no hittable area for Konva to initiate a drag on the outer Group.

* fix(canvas): enable selecting objects inside frames by clicking through border

Always use hollow hitFunc on frame border so interior clicks pass through
to children. When a selected frame's interior is clicked, deselect the
frame instead of re-selecting it, allowing subsequent clicks to reach
child objects directly.

* feat(canvas): enable frame drag from any interior point when selected

When a frame is selected, the user can now drag it by clicking and
dragging from anywhere inside the frame, not just the border edge.
Clicking without dragging inside a selected frame deselects it via
the background Rect's onClick handler (which only fires for non-drag
clicks).

* feat(canvas): move frame name label and toolbar in real-time during drag

Publish frame position to useImageDragStore via onDragMove so the
floating toolbar and frame name label track the frame smoothly while
dragging instead of jumping after drag ends.

* feat(canvas): add hover cursor feedback and refine frame border styling

Add Excalidraw-style 'move' cursor when hovering over draggable canvas
objects in select mode. Introduce useCanvasHoverCursor hook with throttled
hit-testing (16ms) to avoid performance overhead on mouse move events.

Refine frame border to use rounded corners (24px radius) with a solid
8px stroke, replacing the previous thin dashed border. Extract frame
styling constants (FRAME_BORDER_RADIUS, FRAME_BORDER_WIDTH, etc.) and
simplify frame name label styling.

Fix stageRef TDZ error by moving its declaration above first usage.

* fix(canvas): export frame contents without border using offscreen canvas

Replace group.toDataURL() with offscreen canvas approach for frame export
to properly handle stage zoom/pan transforms. The old method rendered with
ancestor transforms, producing oversized images with mispositioned content
at non-100% zoom levels. Also hides frame border during export so the
exported image contains only the frame's children.

* fix(canvas): resolve frame bugs, improve performance, and refine code quality

Address 18 issues from multi-agent code review of the canvas frame feature:

Critical/High fixes:
- Store frame ID during drawing instead of assuming last array element
- Update children positions when frame origin changes during resize
- Replace Konva node mutation with computed absolutePosition callback
- Add early return after frame click to prevent double selection
- Replace O(n*m) child lookup with O(1) Map lookups via useMemo
- Pre-filter children for FrameNode instead of passing full canvasObjects

Medium fixes:
- Use findLast for top-most frame in overlapping containment check
- Extract frame export logic to utils/canvas/frame-export.ts
- Optimize FrameNameLabel to only re-render when its own frame is dragged
- Add useSelectionBasic lightweight hook for hot-path consumers
- Extract hasParentId type guard and findClickedFrame helper
- Fix parentId removal to use spread instead of destructuring
- Add selectFrame to test mocks for type safety

* feat(canvas): enable frame publish button to publish frame content as artwork

Add full publish flow to FloatingFrameActions: NSFW validation of frame
children, frame export to data URL, S3 upload, AI auto-fill of artwork
details, PublishDialog/ShareDialog integration, and private publish with
access tokens. Follows the established panel publish pattern from
canvas-publish-dropdown.tsx.

- Add getFrameImages and validateFrameNsfw to nsfw-validation.ts
- Add i18n keys (publishing, publishSuccess, publishFailed) in en/ja/zh-CN/zh-TW
- Extract shared exportFrameClean helper for download and publish
- Include 13 new unit tests (9 NSFW validation + 4 publish flow)

* fix(canvas): remove persistent loading toast from frame publish flow

The toast.loading during frame export could hang indefinitely if
layer.toCanvas() never resolved, leaving an immortal spinner. Remove
the loading toast entirely and fix the test mock that was missing
toast.dismiss (which masked the dialog-opening code path).

* fix(canvas): hide property panel when frame is selected

The property panel showed empty content when selecting a frame since
frames have no associated properties to display. Add isSingleFrame
exclusion to shouldShowInfoPanel, matching the existing pattern used
for videos and placeholder images.

* feat(canvas): enable direct frame and object dragging without pre-selection

Allow users to drag frames and all canvas objects (images, shapes, tones,
videos, speech bubbles) immediately on click-drag without needing to select
them first. Auto-selects the object on drag start. Adds frame child drag
handling with clip toggling and containment updates.

* fix(canvas): resolve frame bugs, improve performance, and fix code quality issues

- Wrap getObjectsInSelectionRect in useCallback to fix memoization leak (CR-001)
- Use single commitTempCanvasObjects for multi-object arrow-key moves (CR-002)
- Restructure inpaintChildMap from O(n²) to O(n) with two-pass approach (PERF-001)
- Switch FrameNode from useSelectionState (18 subs) to useSelectionBasic (3 subs) (PERF-004)
- Initialize frame dimensions to 1x1 instead of 0x0 to avoid Transformer edge case (CR-007)
- Make keyboard Delete orphan frame children instead of silently deleting them (CR-015)
- Fix 'cavnasObjects' parameter typo in updatePanelPosition (CQ-008)
- Use i18n translation for frame default names instead of hardcoded English (IL-001)

* fix(canvas): remove invalid isGenerating check on VideoObject

VideoObject does not have an isGenerating property (that's an ImageObject
concept). The check was incorrectly copy-pasted from the image rendering
code into both VideoNode and VideoPlaceholderNode draggable props.
